content.text:
working_dir: ./02-backend/formal_completeness_check
    depends_on:
      project-logic-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      formal-completeness:
        condition: process_healthy

  agent-orchestration:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18003 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/agent_orchestration_service
    environment:
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=fvp-task-queue
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1
      - API__PLS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18000
      - API__DMS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18001
      - API__FVP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18002
      - API__DIPLAN_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18004
      - API__PLAUSIBILITY_NOTES_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18005
      - API__OBJECTIONS_SERVICE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18006
      - API__FPP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18007
      - API__EXAMINATION_SERVICE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18009
      - API__ADMINISTRATIVE_FILE_DRAFT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18010
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18003
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  plausibility-notes:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18005 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/plausibility_notes
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=plausibility_notes
      - DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18001
    readiness_probe:

      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure

    working_dir: ./02-backend/identity_management_service
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=identity_management_db
      # /identity/users lists real users from the local Keycloak realm through
      # the local-client service account (view-users).
      - AUTH_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9090
      - AUTH_REALM=local
      - AUTH_CLIENT_ID=local-client
      - AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET}

      - DB__PORT=5432
      - DB__NAME=temporal_job_service_db
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=temporal-job-service
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1

  gesetze-normen-db:
